details:
SPACE EXPLORER – An Interactive Journey Through the Universe

1. What does the project do?

SPACE EXPLORER is an interactive 3D astronomy platform designed to help people explore and understand the Universe.

It allows users to discover our Solar System, explore celestial bodies, visualize orbital movements and learn about real space missions. Instead of simply reading scientific information, users can interact with a 3D environment and explore space at their own pace.

2. How does it work?

The application provides an interactive 3D environment where users can navigate through the Solar System.

Users can:

  • Explore the Sun, eight planets and other celestial bodies, including dwarf planets, moons, asteroids and comets.
  • Select objects to access scientific information.
  • Visualize planetary orbits and movements.
  • Search for celestial objects and navigate through the environment.
  • Discover real spacecraft and space missions, including Voyager 1, Voyager 2, James Webb and New Horizons.
  • Access mission information such as objectives, launch dates and mission status.

The interface combines 3D visualization, navigation tools and scientific information to create an accessible exploration experience.

3. What benefits does it provide?

SPACE EXPLORER makes astronomy more interactive and easier to understand.

It can help students, teachers and astronomy enthusiasts:

  • Understand the structure of our Solar System.
  • Discover the characteristics of planets and moons.
  • Better visualize orbital movements.
  • Learn about humanity's exploration of space.
  • Access astronomical information in one environment.

4. What is the intended impact?

Our objective is to make scientific knowledge more accessible and encourage curiosity about space.

We want users to move beyond simply looking at pictures of planets and begin exploring how celestial objects and space missions relate to one another.

5. What technologies and resources were used?

The project was developed using modern web technologies:

  • React and TypeScript for the application.
  • Three.js for interactive 3D visualization.
  • Web-based tools and libraries for the interface and 3D environment.
  • NASA, JPL and NAIF resources for astronomical and mission-related information.

Scientific references are used to support the information presented. Some visualizations are illustrative or reconstructed when complete observational imagery is unavailable.

6. What makes the project creative?

The main idea behind SPACE EXPLORER is to combine an astronomical atlas, a 3D exploration environment and a space mission discovery platform into one experience.

Rather than presenting isolated facts, the project connects celestial objects, their movements and humanity's exploration of space.

We designed the platform to make exploring the Universe feel intuitive, interactive and educational.

SPACE EXPLORER – Explore. Learn. Discover.
